name: Bulwark Webmail
description: Bulwark is a self-hosted webmail client for Stalwart Mail Server that speaks JMAP. It brings mail, calendar, contacts and Stalwart's file storage together in one interface, with threading, full-text search, Sieve filters, S/MIME, 2FA, multiple accounts and an installable PWA.

notes.text: Without a preset JMAP URL, finish the setup wizard with the token from `journalctl -u bulwark`. It expires after an hour; `systemctl restart bulwark` issues a new one.
Needs Stalwart 0.16.6 or newer over HTTPS with a certificate both the browser and Bulwark trust, and Permissive CORS enabled. A private CA goes into NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS in /opt/bulwark_data/.env.
COOKIE_SECURE=false in /opt/bulwark_data/.env lets sign-in work over plain HTTP; remove it once Bulwark is served through HTTPS.

app_vars.name: var_jmap_url
app_vars.label: Stalwart JMAP URL
app_vars.help: https:// URL of your Stalwart server; leave empty to use the setup wizard
